author_provenance.author: An independently tasked synthetic-corpus agent
author_provenance.authorship: All business scenarios, field definitions, sample values, and decision rationales were authored synthetically for this new reservation. No external data sources or licensed dataset dependencies were used.
author_provenance.evidence_limit: Synthetic independent agent authorship provides limited evidence and is not production validation or a representative estimate of real deployment performance.
author_provenance.ids: Identifiers were randomly created independently of field semantics and decision labels, then fixed in the artifact.
author_provenance.independence_boundary: No existing fixture contents, matcher source algorithms, policy files, or scored results were inspected. No matcher was run or queried. A collaboration status response exposed an unrequested brief implementation summary after all twelve family designs had been specified; no returned detail was used to select, replace, or revise a family. This disclosure limits claims of strict blind independence.
author_provenance.inputs: Matching inputs consist only of ordinary field names, declared types, and optional primitive samples. Concepts and rationales are annotation material. There are no caller SemanticHints or label-derived matcher inputs.
author_provenance.normalization: SHA-256 over the UTF-8 raw JSON text with CRLF and CR converted to LF; no other whitespace normalization.
author_provenance.purpose: Prospective qualification evidence reserved until the matcher implementation and qualification policy are frozen. Score once; do not tune the matcher against these families.

qualification_protocol.adapter_requirement: Family denies extra fields and has no split member. The reserved loader must assign holdout to every listed family and must not derive its split from the legacy corpus partition.

validation.checks: Family allowed members; unique IDs; nonempty concepts and rationales; primitive samples; supported declared types; six source fields; five to nine target fields; every source labeled once; label cardinalities; existing targets; three families per domain.
validation.protocol_constraint: The legacy fixed 40-family corpus loader and fixed 8-family holdout partition do not directly ingest this standalone reservation.

protocol.discipline: Fixed candidate and fixed name-only comparators nominated before any new reserved scoring. A separate agent authored the new families without seeing matcher algorithms, policies, fixtures or results. Freeze implementation, protocols, corpus, configuration, compiler and executable before this one prospective run. Matcher inputs are observable schemas only; labels, concepts, rationales and tags reach only validation and the scorer. No caller hints, confirmations, threshold sweeps or holdout-driven changes. Report each assignment and all families, domains and variants. Older published holdouts remain retired; T2D and corrective reserved partitions remain unscored.
protocol.limits: One agent-authored synthetic holdout with related variants, not independent production adjudication or a confidence bound on deployment accuracy. Success qualifies these fixed synthetic targets; publication remains the maintainer's decision.
